title: add CI release manifests, artifact signing and provenance for private-installer
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Add CI pipeline steps to produce release manifests (Syft SBOM, provenance metadata), sign artifacts with Cosign, and publish signed release-manifests.yaml for private-installer. Enables verifiable private-installer releases and supports air-gapped customers.
description:
Context: Private deployments require cryptographically verifiable delivery artifacts for regulated customers. This PR adds end-to-end CI automation to: 1) generate SBOMs (syft), 2) produce release manifests that enumerate images and artifacts (release-manifests.yaml), 3) sign artifacts and manifests with cosign, and 4) upload signed provenance to the release bucket. Motivation: reduce manual steps in Private Installer releases and provide customers with signed provenance for supply-chain audits.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Adds new GH Actions workflows (ci/release/build-and-publish-release-manifests.yml) that run on release tags; extends existing build scripts to emit syft SBOMs and SLSA-style provenance statements; adds cosign signing steps using the repo's KMS-backed key (consumable via CI secrets); updates Helm chart packaging to include manifest references and signed checksums; exports a consolidated release-manifests.yaml alongside existing release artifacts. The release-manifests.yaml follows the internal schema used by the installer to verify artifact checksums and signatures at install time.

Checklist: - [x] generate syft SBOMs for all images - [x] produce SBOM + provenance per artifact - [x] sign images/artifacts/manifests with cosign - [x] upload signed artifacts to s3 release bucket - [x] update Helm chart and values for private-installer to reference manifests - [x] add integration tests that verify manifest signatures using cosign public key - [x] update docs/release/ to describe release verification flow

Compatibility & upgrade notes: The changes are additive to the release pipeline; existing installers remain supported. Customers using air-gapped installs can now download signed release-manifests.yaml and verify signatures offline using the published cosign public key. No runtime changes to the installer are required; the chart values accept the new manifest URL and optional signature verification flags.

Testing & verification: The branch includes a workflow that runs a dry-run release in a dedicated test bucket. Integration tests (tests/release/test_manifest_verification.sh) emulate customer verification using the published public key. CI initially failed on linting scripts (shellcheck) and Hyphenated variable warnings; those were fixed and the workflow re-ran successfully.

Rollback/rollback plan: If a release with invalid signatures is published, the CI job will fail before promotion; for post-publish issues, release-manifests can be revoked by publishing an updated manifests file with a revocation entry and notifying customers. The PR includes a small helper script ci/release/revoke-manifest.sh to automate revocations for a given tag.

References: Linear ENG-5421 (release automation), ENG-5460 (provenance for private-installer), related PRs: #5178, #5250.
